units.intro: Describe what you own once per batch; the preview derives inventory without extra counters.

units.none: No unit group yet. Add one to continue.

rental.intro: One physical unit, multiple selling methods, one consistent commitment on its inventory.
rental.privacyAck: I verified privacy and access before selling parts
rental.privacyHint: Parts stay locked until this acknowledgment; the system never infers privacy from the name.
rental.partsHint: The system never infers bedrooms; add each part with a clear label, or leave capacity empty to inherit the group capacity.
rental.connectedHint: Enter existing unit codes separated by commas; no resource is created and adjacency is never inferred.
rental.specsHint: Setup is a guest promise, not extra inventory.

operations.explicitStates: I set the initial unit states explicitly

review.separateDenominators: Villas and their parts are never summed into one gross inventory.
review.missingNone: No blocking gaps; the server must still re-validate before opening sale.
review.simulationHint: Simulation only: no reservation is created and no inventory is held.
review.resultWhole: Whole-unit sale blocks all parts ({{parts}}); no part can be sold twice.
review.resultPart: Part sale blocks the whole unit and keeps the other parts available per the sharing policy.
review.resultBed: Bed sale holds up to {{count}} beds in the room scope; the whole room cannot be sold on top.
review.simAllowed: Allowed: the requested resources are free for the period.
review.simBlocked: Not allowed: an existing conflict covers the period.
review.simulationLocal: Local simulation only before saving to the server; apply re-validates.
review.resultExclusive: Exclusive sale blocks the unit for the selected period; availability and readiness stay separate.
review.finishReady: The draft is complete for review. Readiness, opening sale, and any channel activation remain separate server actions.
review.finishBlocked: {{count}} item(s) still need attention before the draft can be reviewed as complete.
